name: auth-failure
description: The credential is accepted by the web server but the iTop user lacks the REST Services User profile, which iTop reports as HTTP 200 with code 1 rather than as a 401. A run that only checked the HTTP status would report an empty CMDB, so the body's own code has to be read.

json.message: Error: the user is not authorized to use the REST services. Missing profile 'REST Services User'
